notes: «قالا حدثنا سفيان» makes Yahya b. Sa'id and Abd al-Rahman b. Mahdi a pair at one level (rule 2)
«وكان، من أصحاب ابن مسعود» describes Abu Hudhayfa and is not part of the name (rule 1)
The Prophet is in the saying's scene; «عائشة» is the last link, her words («قالت حكيت للنبي») being the report
